title: Persona 3 Reload Portfolio
category: Game Console UI & Web Audio Engine
description: Cinematic game-console developer portfolio inspired by Persona 3 Reload, featuring procedural Web Audio synthesis, 1080p character loop videos, and zero-scroll canvas navigation.

featuredSlide.title: Persona 3 Reload
featuredSlide.aboutP1: Most developer portfolios rely on predictable grids and neutral styling. I wanted to break convention by building an authentic, 60 FPS console interface inspired by the aesthetic of Persona 3 Reload.
featuredSlide.aboutP2: I engineered a zero-scroll 1080p viewport interface with procedural Web Audio synthesis for zero-latency feedback, kinetic typography, character video loops, and responsive game-menu state machines.

caseStudy.tagline: Authentic 60 FPS console experience featuring procedural Web Audio synthesis, stylized kinetic typography, and zero-scroll canvas navigation.
caseStudy.system: React 18 · TypeScript · Web Audio API · Tailwind · CSS 3D

problem.headline: Pushing web interactivity beyond sterile modern UI conventions.
problem.description: Most developer portfolios follow identical grid patterns and neutral aesthetics. I wanted to break the mold entirely by building an authentic, 60 FPS console experience inspired by Persona 3 Reload that pushes web browser audio and animation to its absolute limit.

architecture.headline: Procedural Web Audio synthesis and zero-scroll state machines.
architecture.description: Built an acoustic feedback engine using native Web Audio API oscillators and gain nodes (avoiding bulky sound MP3 assets) while providing zero-latency acoustic clicks, thuds, and menu swooshes. Navigation is driven by a finite state machine mimicking console controller inputs.

highlights.title: Procedural Audio Synthesizer
highlights.detail: Native Web Audio API oscillators synthesizing UI mechanical sounds, eliminating audio load latency entirely.

highlights.title: Dynamic Stylized Typography
highlights.detail: Procedural angle, padding, and font-weight jitter algorithms creating the signature Persona 3 Reload visual style.

highlights.title: CSS 3D Diagonal Perspective
highlights.detail: Hardware-accelerated CSS transforms giving menus sharp diagonal angularity without dropping frames.

features.title: Console Menu State Machine
features.description: Full keyboard and mouse navigation modeled after game controller menus with sound feedback.

features.title: 1080p Character Loop Integration
features.description: Hardware-accelerated video loop integration with alpha blending and dynamic UI color shifting.

features.title: Themed Interactive System
features.description: Atmospheric UI system styled with iconic Persona 3 Reload aesthetics and sound design.

takeaways: The Web Audio API is immensely powerful for UI feedback: synthesizing micro-sounds on the fly delivers zero network lag and a tiny bundle footprint.
Crafting bold, rule-breaking aesthetics requires disciplined performance profiling to ensure heavy visual styling doesn't compromise smoothness.
